Color Trim

Your wheel's LEDs are not equally bright per color, and this makes up the difference. Yellow looking green? Bring green down. White looking blue? Bring blue down. Judge it on the rim, not on screen, and move in small steps. Set it once and leave it.

Only the gap between the sliders matters. The highest one is the reference and keeps its color as authored; the others are cut relative to it. Three equal sliders means no correction at all, whatever the number.
Red:
Normally left at 100. Red is usually the dimmest of the three, so there is nothing to gain by cutting it further.
Green:
Show yellow, then bring this down until it stops looking green.
Blue:
Show white, then bring this down until the strip looks neutral rather than tinted.
